_doc: THE one deprecation ledger. Six files used to record retirement (retired-pipeline.json, retired-sources.json, retired-parameters.csv, field-verdicts.json, curated-file-verdicts.json, card-field-spec._removedFields) and six ledgers is how a deleted thing comes back: the next agent finds it in the one file that still lists it as live. New retirements land HERE; the older files keep their reasoning but stop being lists of what is dead. Consumed by scripts/check_docs_integrity.py: a repo path named in CLAUDE.md, docs/AGENTS.md or docs/INDEX.md must exist on disk or appear here with its replacement, so the standard future agents read first cannot quietly describe a system that no longer exists.

entries.why: Was a hand-run script invisible to --fetch, --verify and audit-sources while being the index every CLDF pin resolves through; its output carried no date.
Moved into a source directory so verify() re-hashes it like every other pin.
Read one of five naming conventions and reported a third of the catalogue as all of it.
The pre-atlas card projector. Zero importers remain; its output directory (build/cards-projected) is a stale Aug-4 artifact the disposition audit was once caught grading against.
Only invoker was build-cards.mjs. The atlas projector (project.mjs + project-locales.mjs) replaced it.
The universal CLDF ingester for the LEGACY champollion.db lane, which no card is built from. Extending it puts facts where nothing reads them.
Extractors for the legacy lane; two open champollion.db directly. Still walked by cli/test/extractors.test.js — delete the directory and that test in the same commit.
The retired projector's output, frozen at 2026-08-04. cutover-cards.mjs and the disposition audit once pointed here and graded the new corpus against a week-stale artifact of the old one.
Named in CLAUDE.md as a repair generator but no longer exists — the per-field mutator class it belonged to was archived at the cutover (see cli/scripts/cldf/archive-legacy.mjs).

entries.why: Exported CLDF from the retired legacy facts store; the atlas IS CLDF and build-atlas emits a validated StructureDataset (with license gating at emit). The file remains as a refusal stub so `npm run export:cldf` prints guidance.
CLICS3 ingester for the legacy champollion.db lane; the atlas lane has its own handler.
The superseded CLI-side twin of the trading-card enrichment build; the live build reads the atlas via mt-eval-arena/scripts/lib/atlas.mjs.

Migrated an existing champollion.db to the v3 schema; the store it migrates is retired. The v3 schema guarantees stay covered by cli/test/fact-store-v3.test.js against a temp database via scripts/db.mjs applySchema.
Wrote vitalityStatuses[] onto cards from champollion.db facts; post-atlas the endangerment envelope is projected at build time and the vitality tier is derived at read time by the ONE adapter.
The pre-atlas mass card generator (merge-don't-overwrite mutator); regeneration now means projecting from the atlas and cutting over deliberately, never mutating cards in place.

Accessor for the retired champollion.db fact store. Kept importable ONLY for cli/test/fact-store-v3.test.js (v3 schema guarantees against a temp DB); every CLI entry that wrote through it now refuses to run. Do not wire new consumers.

entries.why: DELETED: unimported copy of the legacy accessor whose openDatabase() silently CREATED an empty database on a missing path — the failure mode mt-eval-arena/scripts/lib/atlas.mjs exists to refuse.

RETIRED 2026-08-18 (Gate 2 of the SSOT cutover). The legacy fact store: 5.66M facts, 70% unpinned sediment from merge-only writers deleted in 96fa5bb1f — not reproducible, so it was frozen, carried over, and deleted rather than migrated. Everything carryable lives in the atlas (3,456,281 pinned forms, the feature catalog, the license floor); everything else is refused by name in docs/FORMS_ORPHAN_TRIAGE_2026-08-18.md + docs/FORMS_PARITY_FINAL_2026-08-18.json. Archive copy (sha256 2d1c2d939a26dab1b77cc20fa23894ffe3d59ea0ead006750471768a5a5df323) retained outside the repo.
